    Given the store "Café 東京 ☕" is open

  Scenario Outline: Add <n> items (<label>)

    Examples: small
      | n | expected | label |
      | 1 | 1 | row-1 |
      | 2 | 2 | row-2 |
      | 3 | 3 | row-3 |
      | 4 | 4 | row-4 |

      | 9 | 9 | row-9 |

      | n | expected | label |
      | 10 | 10 | big-1 ✓ |
      | 20 | 20 | big-2 ✓ |
      | 30 | 30 | big-3 ✓ |
      | 40 | 40 | big-4 ✓ |
      | 50 | 50 | big-5 ✓ |

  Rule: Discounts 💸
    Background:
      Given I am logged in as "zoë"

    Scenario: Apply coupons from a data table
      When I apply coupons:
        | code   | pct |
        | SAVE5  | 5   |

        """json

        """
